newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Nomura buys 33 pct of Lithuania's Ukio Bank.
newsitem.headline: Nomura buys 33 pct of Lithuania's Ukio Bank.

text.p: International securities house Nomura bought 33.3 percent of the share capital of Lithuanian bank, Ukio Bank, Lithuania's central bank said on Friday.
A central bank spokesman said Nomura bought the shares as Ukio Bank raised its share capital from 24 million litas to 42 million litas.

The spokesman said foreigners now owned 55 percent of Ukio Bank shares and that three Lithuanian banks were now more than half-owned by foreigners. Apart from Ukio, leading bank Vilnius Bank and Hermis Bank also have large foreign shareholders.
The rest of Ukio Bankas' shares are owned by local investors and the bank is ranked among the top five banks in Lithuania, the central bank said.
Lithuania has been gradually recovering from a bank crisis that hit it at the end of last year and confidence has been returning to the market.
